title: Request more GPU quota
manualHelp: Manually adjust the existing domain pool and project cap, then mark fulfilled. The server rechecks current limits. Fulfill and reject never change quotas.
requestHelp: Ask an administrator to increase the selected project’s GPU limit. This records a request, not an automatic quota increase.
scopeHelp: Without an explicit project cap, the domain GPU limit is inherited. Caps are not reserved shares; native project CPU/RAM quotas and host capacity also govern VM creation. Direct Nova requests outside Afterglow are not globally governed by this policy.
reloadRequired: Reload requests before submitting or deciding again so the actual outcome can be checked.
inactiveHelp: This pool is unmanaged or paused. You can request capacity, but an administrator must activate the existing domain pool and manually adjust the target limits before fulfillment.
policyUnavailable: Current project, approved GPU profile or pool-policy readiness cannot be verified, so submission is blocked. Request history remains independently available.
noProfiles: No approved GPU profiles are currently available.
alreadyUnlimited: The current limit is already unlimited and cannot be increased.
additionalHelp: Enter a positive integer. The request records an absolute target by adding this to the current effective cap.
pageBound: Up to 50 requests per page. Reload returns to the first page.
conflict: The request or current limits changed, or the target is not met. Adjust limits manually and reload requests.
mutationFailed: The operation failed. Reload requests before trying again.
loadFailed: Requests or current pool could not be verified. Reload to check again.
unknownOutcome: The outcome is unknown. This operation will not be retried automatically. Reload requests to check its actual status.
submitted: Request recorded. Limits were not changed.
privacyHelp: Reasons and review notes are stored and visible to managers of this domain and system administrators. Do not include passwords, tokens or other secrets.
decided: Decision recorded. This operation did not change quotas.
